The season started on 31 July 2026. The league is contested by 10 teams. ==Teams== The following teams are competing in the 2026–27 HNL. ===Club changes=== [[NK Rudeš]] were promoted from the [[2025–26 First Football League (Croatia)|2025–26 Prva NL]] after a two years absence from the top flight while [[HNK Vukovar 1991]] were relegated to the [[First Football League (Croatia)|2026–27 Prva NL]] after one season back in the top flight. ===Stadia and locations=== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center;" |- !
